cases.expected: Local origin/push target, live main, release and tag identities are recorded; no reset to bundled commit.
Unrelated work, existing artwork and all v1.0.0 release/tag/assets remain unchanged.
Active AGENTS guidance routes to v1.0.1 and replaces conflicting exact-runtime/manual gates without removing safety rules.
Regression reproduces 3.14.2 versus exact 3.14.8 rejection and failed -0p followed by PATH discovery; pypdf state remains unknown before import.
Authorized Windows 10 automation availability is recorded; absent access creates one kit plan, not an invented pass.
All four candidate branches evaluated with concrete inclusion/exclusion reasons; security and Windows binary availability reviewed.
One validated policy design is used across setup/probe/PowerShell validation/tests/docs; exact build pins are separate.
Later stable maintenance versions inside approved branches are accepted without exact equality or a live online check.
Each hard floor/exclusion has applicable evidence; recommended latest patch is not silently used as an equality/minimum rule.
Only tested regular stable x64 CPython branches are advertised; 32-bit, ARM, free-threaded and future untested minors are excluded clearly.
Numeric tests cover patch 8, 9 and 10, below/at floor and later stable patches; synthetic future versions are not claimed installed.
PowerShell and Python reach the same policy decision; one layer cannot retain the old exact check or trust ok blindly.
Malformed/missing policy, wrong types/booleans and unsupported schema fail clearly without broad fallback.
Isolated flags, actual executable identity, architecture/GIL checks and package import/distribution origin remain enforced.
A compatible bare interpreter with no pypdf can pass interpreter-only setup probing; processing correctly rejects missing pypdf.
3.14.2 gets the documented policy/security decision rather than an exact 3.14.8 equality rejection; no unsupported promise of safety.
Legacy installed-only launcher listing works and parses concrete executable paths safely.
Installed Python manager listing is handled through a verified read-only route, without runtime install triggers.
Unknown option -0 does not prevent a subsequent trusted PATH interpreter from succeeding.
No launcher plus a valid direct interpreter works; empty/malformed listings are bounded failures rather than hangs.
Invalid explicit Python or broken existing .venv fails without silently switching runtimes.
Document/CWD decoys, import shadowing and unsafe executable aliases remain excluded; valid unrelated-CWD launch still works.
Discovery never launches an installer, changes global settings, queries online runtime lists or hangs indefinitely.
Multiple valid candidates are deduplicated and selected deterministically; diagnostics identify the actual choice.
A bare compatible Python can create the app environment and install the reviewed runtime lock without global pypdf.
A healthy existing environment validates without replacement or unnecessary package downloads.
A broken/unapproved existing environment is preserved by default and has an actionable explicit repair route.
Explicit repair preserves/restores the original environment on failure; unrelated files are not removed.
Setup does not promote a relocated completed venv; the final environment works from its actual final path.
Online/offline installs enforce reviewed hashes/binary packages; a hash mismatch or absent wheel fails without unsafe fallback.
Check mode and normal processing never install, create environments or change global packages/PATH/policy.
Two setups, interruption, locked files and unwritable/reparse paths are handled without deleting user-owned content.
NonInteractive never prompts; missing prerequisites return precise errors. No Python/Calibre auto-install or elevation is hidden in setup.
BAT still runs through Windows PowerShell 5.1 and setup/app parse under the real target host.
Any Windows-11-only API/assumption is replaced narrowly, with equivalent safety and actual tests.
Native evidence uses caption/build/ProductType/architecture, not only ProductName or version 10.0.
Missing Python, incompatible/security-floor Python, missing pypdf and wrong-origin packages have distinct useful guidance.
Version/help queries work without Python/pypdf/Calibre and no new runtime check breaks them.
Every advertised Python minor runs actual application tests; at least two pass. Mocked versions are separate policy tests.
Existing full Python and PS5.1/PS7 reference regression passes with no unexplained removal of safety tests.
Reference developer wheels/tool pins do not recreate an application exact-Python requirement or get installed into runtime-only environments.
Synthetic/redistributable fixtures cover page boundaries, metadata policy and conversion; no personal documents enter tests.
Data-driven tests cover both later patches and blocked/security floor cases without claiming all were actually installed.
Harness verifies ZIP/hash/manifest before safe fresh extraction; no zip traversal, duplicate paths or preexisting target overwrite.
Report records real OS/ProductType/build, tool versions, code/policy/harness identities and actual exit results.
The prepared kit automates BAT/CLI/setup/manual/bookmark/Unicode/non-overwrite/error/cancellation checks using synthetic fixtures.
Kit includes genuine self-authored EPUB and AZW3/KF8 conversion validation without private input or manual PDF counting.
User-launched kit produces one redacted result bundle; raw personal paths remain local and every planned test has an outcome.
No repeated owner guide or screenshot requirement; any unavoidable changed-launcher observation is consolidated into one session.
All advertised minors run on actual x64 interpreters in CI; source SHA and resolved patches are recorded.
Server jobs are explicitly Server evidence and do not stand in for native Windows 10/11.
Pinned reviewed actions and least privilege retained; no untrusted PR execution on a personal self-hosted runner.
Failed/timed-out/missing required jobs block release; green unrelated older runs or skipped suites are not used as evidence.
Current applicable Python/pypdf/Calibre advisories and approved artifact hashes reviewed; no broad untested pypdf acceptance.
Encryption/private reader hook and unsupported active document behavior remain correct under the supported runtimes.
Page coverage/source preservation/non-overwrite/process-tree cleanup/Unicode regression remains passing.
Real EPUB and genuine AZW3 inputs convert/split with expected page coverage; mocked converter success is separate.
PDF setup/processing remains usable without Calibre; converter changes are limited to proven requirements.
Current docs describe actual Windows/Python ranges/floors, setup/check/repair/offline behavior and tested-versus-accepted distinction.
Banner/manifest/package name/setup metadata all agree on 1.0.1; historical v1.0.0 records are not bulk rewritten.
Allowlist includes setup/policy and required runtime files from source; no venv/dev docs/private logs accidentally ship.
Scan confirms active code/docs/setup do not demand one exact Python patch; legitimate build pins/historical records remain labeled.
Unsigned status, Windows10 servicing caveat and remaining format/platform limits are accurate.
Changed policy/discovery/setup/native handling reviewed; critical/security/correctness blockers resolved with actual test evidence.
R is a reviewed integrated commit reachable from main with passing required checks, not a stale unmerged branch.
ZIP/manifest/checksums and member allowlist are audited against R; no uncommitted bytes or manual ZIP edits.
Exact source R and asset hashes fixed before final native runs; comparison of different build-toolchains is not required.
Genuine Windows10 22H2 workstation/VM automated smoke and setup succeed on the exact frozen ZIP; no server/mock substitution.
Genuine Windows11 final-ZIP smoke, PS5.1 and supported PS7 path succeed with actual environment recorded.
Real EPUB/AZW3 conversion and split/source/output validation are evidenced on both OS families.
All final native results refer to accepted ZIP/R, and minimal-human/unchanged-Explorer testing limits are truthful.
Actual tests/security review/CI/native evidence and exact accepted artifacts are complete; no NOT_RUN result becomes PASS.
Local and live peeled v1.0.1 tag equal R; tag and existing v1.0.0 are not moved or replaced.
v1.0.1 is published non-draft/non-prerelease with exact expected assets and truthful tested-scope notes.
Anonymous metadata identifies public non-draft non-prerelease v1.0.1 and required assets.
Anonymous ZIP/manifest/checksum downloads match all accepted hashes and expected sizes/content.
Extracted verified public ZIP runs an automated smoke and matches native-tested ZIP identity.
v1.0.0 public tag/assets and source remain unchanged compared with the starting snapshot.
Post-R closure changes are non-shipped evidence only; release source/tag remain R.
Clean local main equals a fresh live remote main at closure C; no cached-ref or failed-push success.
Final status has public URL/R/artifact hashes/actual coverage/limits and truthful task completion; project is not marked done at a tag/draft.
